0022600039.text: The Rockets come into this home game at 9-3, on a two-game winning streak, 7-3 over their last ten, and one game back of first in the Southwest, while the 1-11 Jazz are on a 10-game losing streak and sit 15th in the West in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Houston will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture) and Trey Alexander (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 140-106 win in Houston on April 3, 2026.
